title: Server Procurement Technical Specification
scope: Example only. Replace all assumptions and thresholds with project-specific values before tender release.
assumptions: CPU architecture requirement is project-specific and currently TBD.
Warranty target is assumed to be 3 years pending procurement confirmation.

requirements.requirement: The server shall provide not less than 24 physical CPU cores in the offered configuration.
requirements.evidence: Official datasheet and configured BOM/ordering information

requirements.requirement: Installed memory shall be at least 128 GB and the platform shall support future memory expansion.
requirements.evidence: Official datasheet showing installed and maximum supported memory

requirements.requirement: The offered configuration shall include at least two 10GbE data interfaces in addition to management connectivity.
requirements.evidence: Configured NIC model/part number and official technical documentation

requirements.requirement: The supplier shall provide at least 3 years of manufacturer or manufacturer-authorized support.
